action_confirmations_resolution_shape.name: action_confirmations_resolution_shape
action_confirmations_resolution_shape.value: ("action_confirmations"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "action_confirmations"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "action_confirmations"."resolved_by" IS NULL) OR ("action_confirmations"."status" <> 'PENDING' AND "action_confirmations"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

expense_sheet_bindings_ready_shape.name: expense_sheet_bindings_ready_shape
expense_sheet_bindings_ready_shape.value: "expense_sheet_bindings"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("expense_sheet_bindings"."spreadsheet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "expense_sheet_bindings"."sheet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "expense_sheet_bindings"."lease_owner" IS NULL)

memories_type_shape.name: memories_type_shape
memories_type_shape.value: ("memories"."memory_type" = 'episodic' AND "memories"."semantic_type" IS NULL) OR ("memories"."memory_type" = 'semantic' AND "memories"."semantic_type" IS NOT NULL)

memories_validity_window.name: memories_validity_window
memories_validity_window.value: "memories"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "memories"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "memories"."valid_until" >= "memories"."valid_from"
